Original Decipher card face for [[Stormtrooper Cadet]] (Official Tournament Sealed Deck), as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/images/stormtroopercadet.gif stormtroopercadet.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021222014653/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/images/stormtroopercadet.gif Internet Archive], 22 December 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: 569b000be4cc06d06a862f3b04384897d1be2212c5bb47895c7322dc1300b755.

Edits: none. The file is the archived GIF byte for byte.

This replaces [[:File:OTSD-D-stormtroopercadet-pc-crop.gif]] (formerly misnamed OTSD-D-stormtroopercadet-decipher-archive.gif), which is a Players Committee copy, not Decipher's scan. The PC Holotable face is [[:File:OTSD-D-stormtroopercadet.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
